sources.note: On Kasanga: only that Buy has two dialectal varieties, Kobiana (guβuy) and Kasanga (guhaaja) (p. 324), and one Kasanga noun form cited from Bühnen 1988. Says Kobiana is a two-tone (H/L) language following Doneux 1991; nothing on Kasanga prosody or stress.
Stubs; cite only Ethnologue and Wilson 2007. Nothing on phonology.

sources.note: The only sketch-length primary description of Kasanga; Portuguese colonial-era sketches routinely note 'acento' placement. Digitized in full at Memória de África (page-image viewer), but the host refuses TLS connections by automated download; only six cover pages are in Arquivo.pt. Needs downloading from another network or a library scan (BCGP held in print).
